newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on short-covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended higher on Wednesday on short-covering by individual investors, but dealers said the index might take a plunge on Thursday ahead of the Friday-Saturday weekend.
"A technical correction was expected as the market was over-sold," dealer Salman Ahmad of Finex Securities said.
He said the rise might not be sustainable as the speculators would short-sell as soon as they square their earlier positions.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 13.41 points, or one percent, to end at 1,353.34.
Losers led gainers 122 to 81. Turnover fell to 20.86 million shares from 21.62 million in the previous session on Tuesday.

Muslim Commercial Bank rose 0.90 rupees to 31.15 rupees. Dewan Salman Fibre rose 1.80 to 32.80. Hub Power Co rose 0.55 to 31.85, Sui Northern Gas rose 1.50 to 32 and Pakistan State Oil 2.0 to 261. PTCL rose 0.40 to 25.50. ICI Pakistan rose 0.50 to 17.50. Wednesday Previous
